t: What Building Retrofit Database Is All About
title: What Building Retrofit Database Is All About
description: Building retrofits upgrade the existing: insulation and air sealing (the cheapest kWh is the negawatt), heat pumps replacing furnaces (3x efficiency), LED relighting, and seismic bracing.
